zh-CN.portal.usage.lan.desc: 站点已内置 D3.js 与全部课程数据，无需外网、也无需启动服务器：双击 index.html 即可离线浏览；要分享给同学，直接把整个 site 文件夹发过去。
zh-CN.portal.about.theory.desc: 陈为《可视化导论》、Mackinlay 1986、Stevens 1946、Cleveland 1984、Bostock D3 官方文档、Card 1999 数据流模型。
zh-CN.portal.about.principle.desc: 案例为中心，而不是理论为中心。每个知识点都嵌入实践案例，配关键点解释与可运行演示。
zh-CN.portal.about.stack.desc: 零构建：纯 HTML + CSS + ES modules + 本地 D3.js v7。内容与呈现分离（正文存于 assets/data/*.json），中英双语单一数据源。
zh-CN.portal.about.data.desc: 新生数据 CSV 与 Crime 数据等都已打包进各章 data/ 目录，浏览器 fetch 加载，离线可用。
zh-CN.card-01.title: 数据
zh-CN.card-01.desc: 从 DeepSeek 合成新生数据出发，展开数据生成、DIKW、Stevens 测量尺度、Mackinlay 视觉通道、D3 数据变换与 Data-Join 三态。
zh-CN.card-01.tags: DIKW 金字塔 · Stevens 4 尺度 · 8 个 D3 变换函数 · Selection 三态
zh-CN.card-02.title: 数据可视化流程
zh-CN.card-02.desc: Card 数据流模型、新生数据 → 分类树 → 树形列表的完整链路，Reingold-Tilford 布局、DOM 事件机制。
zh-CN.card-02.tags: Card 模型 · d3.rollup · Reingold-Tilford · 事件委托
zh-CN.card-03.title: 色彩专题
zh-CN.card-03.desc: 独立专题：颜色是可视化基础。颜色模型 + colormap + Lab 色域 + 5 大色系 + 经典科研配色 + 对错案例 + 鲜艳+低饱和哲学生成器 + CVD 论文图测。8 小节，配色一站式。
zh-CN.card-03.tags: 4 颜色空间 + CVD · Wong / Paul Tol · 5 大色系规则 · 鲜艳+低饱和 · CVD 论文图测
zh-CN.card-04.title: 低维数据可视化
zh-CN.card-04.desc: Crime 数据坐标变换、10 种曲线拟合、Cleveland 45° 倾角、Marching Squares 等值线，共 5 小节。
zh-CN.card-04.tags: 三层坐标变换 · 10 种曲线 · Cleveland 45° · Marching Squares
zh-CN.card-05.title: 时序数据可视化
zh-CN.card-05.desc: 5 个时间属性、法国人名时间序列、van Wijk 日历热图、阿基米德螺旋日历、Storyline 故事线（《侏罗纪公园》案例）。
zh-CN.card-05.tags: 时间分解 · 日历 colormap · 极坐标变换 · Storygraph

en-US.portal.title: Introduction to Visualization
en-US.portal.intro: Click any card to enter a chapter. Each chapter has three tabs — Explain / Key Code / Demo — so you can read and run side by side.
en-US.portal.hero.subtitle: From Data to Charts: A Hands-on JavaScript + D3.js Course
en-US.portal.hero.meta: China University of Petroleum (Huadong) · Instructor: Li Xin · Main reference: Chen Wei’s 《Introduction to Visualization》
en-US.portal.dashboard.title: Progress Overview
en-US.portal.dashboard.desc: Progress is stored in your browser only — never uploaded.
en-US.portal.cards.color-bold: Color is the foundation of visualization
en-US.portal.usage.classroom.title: Classroom Teaching
en-US.portal.usage.classroom.desc: Open any chapter, pick a section on the left, switch between Explain / Code / Demo tabs at the top. Lecture while the demo runs live.
en-US.portal.usage.student.title: Student Self-Study
en-US.portal.usage.student.desc: Work through every key point in chapter order. Each comes with a "why it is written this way" and a "what to watch out for" note. Hit "Mark as learned" and your progress is saved automatically.
en-US.portal.usage.teacher.title: Teacher Preparation
en-US.portal.usage.teacher.desc: Each chapter has its own demo/ subfolder. Run, modify, and package demos separately for students.
en-US.portal.usage.lan.title: LAN / Offline Use
en-US.portal.usage.lan.desc: D3.js and all course data are bundled — no internet and no server. Double-click index.html to browse offline; to share, just send the whole site folder.
en-US.portal.about.theory.desc: Chen Wei's Introduction to Visualization, Mackinlay 1986, Stevens 1946, Cleveland 1984, Bostock's D3 docs, Card 1999 data-flow model.
en-US.portal.about.principle.desc: Case-centered rather than theory-centered. Every concept is grounded in a hands-on case, with a key-point explanation and a runnable demo.
en-US.portal.about.stack.desc: Zero build: plain HTML + CSS + ES modules + local D3.js v7. Content is separated from presentation (prose lives in assets/data/*.json); bilingual text has a single source.
en-US.portal.about.data.desc: Student CSV + Crime CSV etc. are packaged into each chapter's data/. Loaded via fetch — works offline.
en-US.card-01.title: Data
en-US.card-01.desc: Starting from DeepSeek-synthesized student data: data generation, DIKW, Stevens measurement scales, Mackinlay visual channels, D3 transformations and the Data-Join three-state model.
en-US.card-01.tags: DIKW · Stevens 4 scales · 8 D3 ops · Selection
en-US.card-02.title: Visualization Workflow
en-US.card-02.desc: The Card data-flow model, the full pipeline from student data to classification tree to tree list, Reingold-Tilford layout, DOM event mechanics.
en-US.card-03.title: Color
en-US.card-03.desc: Standalone topic: color is the foundation of visualization. Color models + colormap + Lab gamut + 5 harmonies + classic palettes + right/wrong cases + vivid+low-sat generator + CVD test. 8 sections, one-stop.
en-US.card-03.tags: 4 spaces + CVD · Wong / Paul Tol · 5 harmonies · Vivid+Low-Sat · CVD test
en-US.card-04.title: Low-Dim Visualization
en-US.card-04.desc: Crime data axis transformation, 10 curve types, Cleveland 45° slope perception, Marching Squares contours. 5 sections.
en-US.card-05.title: Time Series Visualization
en-US.card-05.desc: 5 time attributes, French names time series, van Wijk calendar heatmap, Archimedean spiral, Storyline (Jurassic Park case).
en-US.card-05.tags: Time props · Calendar colormap · Polar transform · Storygraph
en-US.supp.title: Supplementary Demo Collection
en-US.supp.tagline: Hands-on exercises paired with the course chapters — open and modify them independently.

en-US.supp.hint4: Maps to 4.1 Data Transformation / 4.3 Curve Fitting / 4.5 Contour Lines
